in_hebrew.name: Bearce
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bearer of strength
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bearce הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English 'beara' meaning 'to carry' and 'ceos' meaning 'strength'. The name Bearce was given to those who carried heavy burdens or displayed great strength.

in_greek.name: Bearce
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bearer of strength
in_greek.long_meaning: Bearce είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English 'beara' meaning 'to carry' and 'ceos' meaning 'strength'. The name Bearce was given to those who carried heavy burdens or displayed great strength.

in_latin.name: Bearce
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bearer of strength
in_latin.long_meaning: Bearce est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English 'beara' meaning 'to carry' and 'ceos' meaning 'strength'. The name Bearce was given to those who carried heavy burdens or displayed great strength.
